_note: REAL MONEY, backtest sizing at tiny scale: the 3 strongest golden rules (x_exit, sized_exit, scalp) in the backtest's priority, the backtest's Kelly sizing on a $0.25 base (up to 5x = $1.25 on the strongest gaps), at most 5 contracts; when a signal is worth less than one contract, exactly 1 contract is bought if it costs at most $1 (the backtest takes those trades at fractional size). Safety caps (the only deliberate differences from the backtest): per 15-minute window across all coins at most $1.50 spent and 2 bets on the same side; at most $1.50 at risk at once; new bets stop for the day once losses plus money at risk reach $1.50; per coin $1 daily loss cap and 15 trades. Stops for good below $0.50. Run only from the account holder's own verified (18+) Kalshi account.
